Macro backdrop is overwhelmingly geopolitics-driven with very high unscheduled-surprise share, which argues for humility across all leans.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the gate-eligible theme with the strongest durability profile: trend Hurst, full 1.0 breadth, 0.85 durability bar, second-highest momentum score and current headline narrative.
